# InlineMessage

A short status message attached to a field, row or card section, with a status glyph and text and no dismiss.

`SongNodes.InlineMessage` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.InlineMessage status="ok">…</SongNodes.InlineMessage>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.InlineMessage" status="ok">…</x-import>
```

## Props (InlineMessageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` * | `"ok" \| "fair" \| "warn" \| "bad" \| "info"` | Status glyph and colour: ● ok, ◐ fair, ▲ warn, ✕ bad, i info. |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Message text; bold the key part with <strong>. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | Optional link that jumps to the thing ("Show them"). No dismiss. |
| `boxed` | `boolean` | Tinted box for card sections; plain under fields and in rows. |
| `id` | `string` | id so a field can point aria-describedby at the message. |
